title: USD Sets Fresh Yearly High as EUR/USD Drops Dramatically, USD/JPY Stable
text: USD strength ran rampant again this week as the Dollar burst through a number of resistance levels, including the key Fibonacci level of 101.80 which had previously held the highs in June of this year. And, interestingly, while it was the carry trade in USD/JPY that was a large source of USD strength leading into Q3, last week saw the USD/JPY pair in somewhat of a calm manner.

title: US Dollar Falls Against Pound, Euro After Weak US Jobs Report
text: Weak US payrolls lift GBP/USD towards 1.3260 as ING questions further Fed tightening, while still expecting a December hike. The US Dollar fell against Pound Sterling, the Euro and the Australian Dollar on Friday after September's jobs report weakened the case for another Federal Reserve rate increase this month.
